STATEMENT: For any list `l` of elements of type `α` and a symmetric relation `R`, if `l` is pairwise related under `R`, then for any element `x` in `l`, the relation `R` holds between `x` and its successor in `l` (if it exists).

  cases l with
  | nil => contradiction
  | cons x' xs =>
    have hx' : x' ∈ xs := by
      rw [List.mem_cons] at hx
      cases hx
    have hl' : List.Pairwise R xs := by
      rw [List.pairwise_cons] at hl

    | cons x'' xs'' =>
      have hx'' : x'' ∈ xs'' := by
        rw [List.mem_cons] at hx'
        cases hx'
      have R_x_x'' : R x'' x'' := by
